coordinate_reference: ISMN longitude/latitude used as EPSG:4326; no coordinate transformation
processing: No quality filtering, gap filling, interpolation, or missing-value substitution
product: GLDAS native 0.25 degree static soil texture, fractions and porosity
source_depth_coverage: Top-layer texture only; NASA uses top-layer information for all GLDAS model layers
source_depth_note: Native top-layer source fields repeated daily. Fractions follow Reynolds/FAO-derived maps; texture GLDAS2/Noah FAO16, porosity GLDAS2/Catchment. Preserve distinct parameterization provenance.
